name: AutoMeshLOD3D
author: Twillion
shortDescription: Background Web Worker QEM mesh decimation, zero-cost index swapping, and HLOD sector cluster baking.
description: Automatically generates high-fidelity LOD1 and LOD2 triangle reduction levels in background Web Workers without frame drops, swaps index buffers in 0ms on the GPU, and bakes sector prop clusters into unified single-draw-call proxy meshes for WorldPartition3D.

eventsBasedBehaviors.name: AutoMeshLOD3D
eventsBasedBehaviors.description: Generates asynchronous LOD index buffers in Web Workers and manages distance-based LOD swapping.

propertyDescriptors.name: LOD1Distance
propertyDescriptors.label: LOD1 Distance (Meters)
propertyDescriptors.description: Distance in meters where model swaps to LOD1.

propertyDescriptors.name: LOD1Reduction
propertyDescriptors.label: LOD1 Reduction (%)
propertyDescriptors.description: Triangle reduction percentage for LOD1 (10% to 90%).

propertyDescriptors.name: LOD2Distance
propertyDescriptors.label: LOD2 Distance (Meters)
propertyDescriptors.description: Distance in meters where model swaps to LOD2.

propertyDescriptors.name: LOD2Reduction
propertyDescriptors.label: LOD2 Reduction (%)
propertyDescriptors.description: Triangle reduction percentage for LOD2 (10% to 95%).

propertyDescriptors.name: ShadowCutoff
propertyDescriptors.label: Shadow Cutoff Distance (Meters)
propertyDescriptors.description: Distance in meters beyond which shadow casting is disabled.

eventsFunctions.name: onCreated
eventsFunctions.description: Initializes the AutoMeshLOD3D background decimation engine.

eventsFunctions.name: doStepPostEvents
eventsFunctions.description: Evaluates camera distance and applies zero-cost shared index buffer LOD swapping.

eventsFunctions.name: SetLODDistance
eventsFunctions.description: Dynamically updates the transition distance in meters for a specific LOD tier (1 or 2).

eventsFunctions.name: ForceLODLevel
eventsFunctions.description: Manually overrides the active LOD level (-1 = Auto, 0 = Base/Full, 1 = LOD1, 2 = LOD2).

parameters.name: Level
parameters.description: LOD tier (-1 for Auto, 0 for Base, 1 for LOD1, 2 for LOD2)

eventsFunctions.name: BakeHLODCluster
eventsFunctions.sentence: Bake HLOD cluster from objects into proxy on _PARAM0_
eventsFunctions.description: Merges and decimates multiple static prop meshes into a unified single-mesh proxy for WorldPartition3D.

parameters.name: TriangleBudget
parameters.description: Target triangle count budget for cluster (e.g. 1000)

eventsFunctions.name: IsLODLevel
eventsFunctions.description: Checks if the object is currently rendering at the specified LOD level (0, 1, or 2).

eventsFunctions.name: IsDecimationComplete
eventsFunctions.description: Returns true once the background Web Worker finishes generating index buffers.

eventsFunctions.name: CurrentLODLevel
eventsFunctions.description: Returns the active LOD level index (0 = Base, 1 = LOD1, 2 = LOD2).

eventsFunctions.name: CurrentTriangleCount
eventsFunctions.sentence: Get live rendered triangle count on _PARAM0_
eventsFunctions.description: Returns the number of triangles currently being rendered for this model.

eventsFunctions.name: OriginalTriangleCount
eventsFunctions.sentence: Get original baseline triangle count on _PARAM0_
eventsFunctions.description: Returns the un-decimated baseline triangle count of the base 3D model.
